items.title: 5.1.2 Role of Models in Decision-Making (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Models masle par sochne ka munazzam tareeqa dete aur pecheeda maloomat ko aasan banate hain, jo faisla sazi mein sab se ahem hai, jahan yeh intikhab se pehle mukhtalif nataij par ghaur karne dete hain. Kisan mausam ke andaaz aur mitti ki halat ka model istemal kar ke beej bone ka behtareen waqt bata sakta aur achhi fasal ka imkan barha sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Asal duniya ke masail hal karne mein statistical models ka kirdar aur ahmiyat samjhaiye (long question 1).
blocks.explanation: Statistical model purane data se batata hai ke variables kaise jure hain, to yeh andaaz samjha aur naye cases ki pesh-goi kar sakta hai. Yeh pecheeda soorat ko munazzam karta (customers aur kamai, parhai ke ghante aur nataij), amal se pehle nataij ka muwazna karne deta (kab bona, kitna stock rakhna), ghaltiyon aur imkanaat se ghair yaqeeniyat naapta, aur naye data par jaancha jata hai ta ke faisle saboot par hon. Istemal: mausam ki pesh-goi, maali andaze, tib aur sciencei tehqeeq; models ko munsif aur privacy ka khayal rakhne wala bhi hona chahiye.

items: Models pecheeda maloomat munazzam karte aur faisle se pehle nataij ka muwazna karne dete hain (kisan ka bone ka waqt).
